component.name: Norn
component.summary: Stage, commit and manage Git repositories

description.p: A graphical Git client laid out like a file manager: a side pane listing branches, remotes, tags, stashes, worktrees and submodules, and a main area showing either the working copy or the commit history.
Everyday work is covered end to end:

ul.li: Stage and unstage whole files, individual hunks, or single lines
Commit, amend, and push — including force pushing with a lease, showing exactly which commits would be destroyed first
Branches, merging, and conflict resolution with the right choices offered for each kind of conflict
A commit graph, with cherry-pick, revert and interactive rebase
Remotes, tags, stashes, linked worktrees and submodules
Editing files in place, with syntax highlighting
